 We are so excited to announce Christmas festivities at the historic courthouse this year! 
 Join us November 28, 2026 (the Saturday after Thanksgiving) at 4:30 pm to help us kick-off the holiday season! 
 On the lawn downtown, and inside the main floor of the courthouse, we will have: 
 Christmas tree lighting 
 Local music students singing your favorite carols 
 Free photos with Santa + a free book to first 50 visitors 
 Santa’s mailbox he will be taking back to the North Pole 
 Cookies 
 Hot Cocoa 
 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐦𝐚𝐬 𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞 is free and all are welcome. 
 We would like to thank our gracious sponsors and participants for making it all possible: 
 First National Bank of Tennessee , Jesse Lowe, The Real Estate Collective- Crossville , Crossville Rotary Club , Jim “Pa” Buck as Santa Claus, and music students from Crab Orchard Elementary, Homestead Elementary , North Cumberland Elementary , South Cumberland Elementary , and Stone Elementary . 
 Date: Saturday, November 28, 2026 (The Saturday after Thanksgiving) 
 Time: 4:30 PM 
 Location: Historic Courthouse Lawn & Main Floor (Downtown) 
 Admission: Free and open to all 
 Event Highlights
 Christmas tree lighting 
 Carols sung by local music students 
 Free photos with Santa (plus a free book for the first 50 visitors) 
 Santa’s mailbox for letters to the North Pole 
 Complimentary cookies and hot cocoa 
 Special thanks to our sponsors and participants: First National Bank of Tennessee, Jesse Lowe, The Real Estate Collective- Crossville, Crossville Rotary Club, Santa Claus (Jim “Pa” Buck), and students from Crab Orchard, Homestead, North Cumberland, South Cumberland, and Stone Elementary Schools.

 CITY OF CROSSVILLE ANNOUNCES PROPERTY TAX DEADLINE FOR NOVEMBER 30, 2026
 Shea James 0 Like Post 
 Property owners in the City of Crossville have until Monday, November 30, 2026, to pay their local property taxes before late fees go into effect. 
 Payments received after the due date will be subject to interest and penalties calculated at a rate of 1.5% per month. 
 Payments can be made in person at City Hall, located at 392 N. Main St., operating Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
